text:
maya (People Ops): Live Q&A follow-up from today's all-hands about remote/hybrid policies + offsite ops. I'll answer quick bullets and drop links.

leo (Product): For cross-zone travel (e.g., SF -> London) on a 10-day offsite, do we book round-trip economy or can teams request business for long hauls?

maya (People Ops): Default = economy for flights under 8 hours. For flights >8 hours, wingspan rule: economy plus option for premium economy with approval, business only with exec sign-off or medical need. Submit exceptions via the travel-exception form.

ana (Finance): If booking premium, include cost justification and cost-code. We can approve expedited or premium when it's cheaper overall (e.g., saves a hotel night).

sasha (Eng-Infra): Are there quarantine/vaccine/testing costs covered for international offsites?

carlos (People Ops): We cover required COVID tests, visas, and mandated quarantine hotel nights when they're part of company-mandated travel. Personal extensions are not covered. Always check the travel checklist for country-specific rules.

rebecca (People Ops): Accessibility note: if anyone on your team needs a private room, dietary restrictions, or an on-site caregiver, mark that on the offsite request early. We prioritize inclusivity.

leo (Product): How granular should the offsite budget be? We normally plan per-team but want a single PO.

maya (People Ops): Recommended: line-items for travel, lodging, meals, venue, A/V, and contingency (10%). Use the offsite budget template in the kit and pick one charge code for the PO. If multiple teams share, list splits in the notes.

ana (Finance): Pro tip: use cost-code format `team:<team-name>:offsite:<year>` so we can auto-allocate during close.

sasha (Eng-Infra): Logistics: moving hardware for demos. Need to ship 2 dev boxes to the venue. Insurance?

carlos (People Ops): Any equipment shipment >$1,500 must go through IT for serial tracking and legal for asset transfer. Use the hardware-move form; we buy insurance for vendor-shipped items only.

leo (Product): Day passes for visitors — clients attending half a day. How handled?

maya (People Ops): Clients require a visitor agreement and a sponsor. For half-day visits use the visitor registration form; food & beverage for guests is covered but client travel is not.

rebecca (People Ops): Remote/hybrid etiquette from the all-hands: managers asked for a simple checklist to run hybrid sessions. We'll publish a 1-pager: mic check, share slides early, remote-first facilitation tips.

offsite-bot: poll created "Offsite format preference" — options: in-person heavy / hybrid-first / fully remote. Results in 48h.

leo (Product): Meals policy — can we expense team dinner (alcohol included) for a 3-day offsite?

carlos (People Ops): Small team dinners allowed. Alcohol up to 25% of meal spend; don't use company card for personal alcohol. For larger events submit catering budget and attendee list.

ana (Finance): Reminder: all receipts attached in Expensify within 14 days. For multi-currency expenses, include card charge screenshots for FX reconciliation.

sasha (Eng-Infra): Desk booking reminder: if your team wants recurring desks, file a recurring-book request. Hot-desk windows open 2 weeks ahead; multi-day bookings auto-assign lockers.

maya (People Ops): Pet policy for satellite offices: Emotional support animals require documentation; service animals allowed. File ahead so facilities can prep.

leo (Product): One last thing — will leadership publish the offsite headcount cap per team? Some teams are unsure how many can attend.

maya (People Ops): We recommend starting with 10-12 people for focused offsites. For larger all-hands style events, we'll publish venue limits during approvals. If you need more headcount, include reasons in the request.

rebecca (People Ops): I'll synthesize this thread into a pinned FAQ and update the offsite kit. If you need an exception, DM @carlos or @maya with the form and rationale.

maya (People Ops): Thanks all — summary + links posted to #people-ops shortly. Tag us for fast-tracked approvals. :sparkles:
